data.title: 火打谷爱衣 · 玻璃杯擦得亮亮的
data.description: 午后的客人还没到，爱衣站在吧台里擦杯子。她把杯口朝窗边转了转，确认没有水痕，才满意地放到整齐的一排里。
data.promptProse: Mei stands behind the cafe counter in a muted violet shirt and dark denim apron. She wipes a clear drinking glass with a clean cloth, turning its rim toward the window to check for water marks. The empty glasses stand in a neat row beside her under soft daylight.
data.animaCaption: One hand supports the glass base while the cloth in the other hand polishes its outer wall.
data.action: 擦亮玻璃杯并对光检查水痕
